query: I have a 72-year-old woman admitted with ACS. For females aged 67–77 with ACS and initial Troponin T above the 99th percentile, report patient/admission counts and initial troponin mean, median, IQR.
final_sql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.subject_id) FROM patients p JOIN admissions a ON p.subject_id = a.subject_id WHERE p.gender = 'F' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM age(CURRENT_DATE, p.dob)) BETWEEN 67 AND 77 AND p.had_acse = 1) AS patient_count, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.hadm_id) FROM admissions a JOIN labevents l ON a.hadm_id = l.hadm_id WHERE l.itemid = 817987 AND percentile_cont(0.99) within GROUP (ORDER BY l.value) < l.value) AS admission_count, (SELECT AVG(l.value) FROM labevents l WHERE l.itemid = 817987 AND percentile_cont(0.99) within GROUP (ORDER BY l.value) < l.value) AS avg_troponin, (SELECT MEDIAN(l.value) FROM labevents l WHERE l.itemid = 817987 AND percentile_cont(0.99) within GROUP (ORDER BY l.value) < l.value) AS median_troponin, (SELECT (percentile_cont(0.75) within GROUP (ORDER BY l.value) - percentile_cont(0.25) within GROUP (ORDER BY l.value)) AS interquartile_range FROM labevents l WHERE l.itemid = 817987 AND percentile_cont(0.99) within GROUP (ORDER BY l.value) < l.value) AS interquartile_range;
